title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Solutions
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

As the Senior Product Marketing Manager for Solutions, you will be owning the positioning and messaging for 5-7 industries and will be responsible for setting the go-to-market strategy for integrating new technologies and features into Verkada’s broader marketing and sales efforts. This role is highly cross-functional and will work closely with key stakeholders across the Product, Sales, and Marketing organizations. 

You will be integral in developing the collateral needed to support GTM motions in these industries and develop new ways for teams across Verkada to reach and communicate with existing and prospective customers.

What’s You’ll Do

• Develop industry positioning and competitively differentiated messaging based on customer research, industry insights, and product knowledge.

• Bring new products and features to market through an industry lens by taking the lead on content creation - planning, creating/managing deliverables and timelines in order to maximize impact

• Work closely with Brand, Creative, and Demand Generation teams to increase market presence and drive pipeline through key outbound assets (video, webinars, thought leadership, tradeshow collateral, email nurture, etc).

• Partner with Channel and Sales Enablement teams to effectively position our products, leveraging internal tools and developing assets that help improve win rates.

• Become an industry subject matter expert, evangelist, and cross-functional leader who unites Marketing, Sales, and Enablement teams to drive business results.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS or IoT

• Bachelor’s required

• MBA preferred or graduating from an accredited MBA program in 2027

• Ideal candidates have experience developing positioning and messaging across a portfolio of products

• Self-directed and able to operate independently in a fast-paced environment

• Exceptional writing skills with meticulous attention to detail and ability to write content for a variety of audiences

• Experience working cross-functionally with teams including Demand Generation, Sales, Creative, Enablement, and Product.

• Willingness to travel domestically for events and conferences

Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

• Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

• Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage

• Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions

title: Engineering Manager, Atlas (Spatial Systems)
description:

About the Team

Atlas is the founding engineering team responsible for the Maps mandate at Verkada. Our mission is to transform the physical world into a high-performance, interactive digital twin. We build the Spatial Systems -the core rendering engine, tiling infrastructure, and collaborative APIs-that power the visual interface for our entire product ecosystem.

The Platform Mandate

Atlas does not build siloed features. We build a Spatial Platform that our core Product Teams-including Cameras, Access Control, Sensors, Alarms, and Admin -use as their canvas. You will be responsible for ensuring that as we scale to 8+ product lines, the map remains a performant, unified, and "multiplayer" experience.

What You’ll Do

• Zero-to-One Execution: Act as a "Player-Coach" to build the V1 of our Spatial System from the ground up. You will own the initial delivery of our image pipeline and set the technical standards for our collaborative editing protocols.

• Platform Architecture: Lead the design of a modular, plugin-based architecture. You will define the SDKs and APIs that allow 8+ Product Teams (Cameras, Access Control, Alarms, etc.) to overlay their specialized data onto our maps seamlessly.

• Data Ingestion Strategy: Oversee the development of the systems that transform unstructured source data-blueprints, CAD files, and high-res imagery-into clean, topologically sound vector data using ML and automated processing.

• Hire & Mentor: Build the founding Atlas team from scratch (4-6 engineers). You will establish the engineering culture, from code review standards to architectural RFC processes, focusing on high-performance graphics and spatial math.

• Stakeholder Partnership: Act as the primary technical diplomat for the Maps mandate. You will negotiate technical boundaries with other Product EMs to ensure a unified user experience across the entire [Company Name] suite.

What You Bring

• Execution Bias & Technical Grit: You thrive in the high-ambiguity phase of a zero-to-one build. You are a builder who prioritizes shipping high-utility foundations over perfect abstractions, with a proven ability to translate a high-level vision into a tangible, functioning platform in weeks, not months.

• Strategic Communication: The ability to negotiate technical boundaries with other product teams, ensuring a consistent user experience across the entire Verkada "Command" suite.

• UI Depth & Sophistication: You have led the development of highly complex, state-heavy web or mobile applications. You understand the performance trade-offs of rendering thousands of interactive entities and have a deep grasp of modern frontend architectures (React, WebGL/WebGPU, Swift/Kotlin).

• Data Pipeline & ML Maturity: You have experience building sophisticated data pipelines that handle unstructured data at scale.

title: Senior ATE Test Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Senior Automated Test Equipment (ATE) Test Engineer, you will own the bring-up and operation of our high-volume 300 mm wafer test infrastructure for electronic-photonic integrated circuits. On a daily basis, you will set up and qualify ATE test cells, develop and debug test programs for DC, RF, and electro-optical device characterization, and drive probe card design with vendors. You will analyze wafer-level data to make pass/fail calls and share insights with design and process teams, helping us scale from engineering characterization to high-volume production.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

- Set up, qualify, and calibrate ATE test cells, ensuring readiness for high-volume wafer testing.

- Develop and debug automated test programs for DC, RF, optical, and electro-optical device characterization, including new measurement methods.

- Own probe card specifications, design, qualification, and integration, alongside associated interface hardware, in collaboration with vendors.

- Collaborate across teams to define comprehensive measurement plans and contribute to design-for-test (DFT) implementation.

- Collect, analyze, and report wafer-level measurement data to determine pass/fail outcomes and support yield monitoring, reliability testing, and failure analysis.

- Transfer laboratory characterization methods into production, developing automated test protocols and equipment specifications for manufacturing integration.

- Optimize test throughput while maintaining measurement accuracy and reliability.

- Work with manufacturing engineering to implement statistical process control (SPC), improve yield, and strengthen test efficiency and data analytics.

- Support supplier qualification, vendor evaluation, and incoming material characterization.

- Create test documentation and training materials, ensuring procedures meet industry standards and customer quality requirements.

Your Qualifications

- Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.

- At least five years of hands-on experience setting up and operating ATE systems, including wafer probers and probe card specification, qualification, and integration.

- Strong programming skills in Java and Python for test automation, instrument control, and automated data collection.

- Hands-on experience performing electrical, optical, and electro-optical measurements on EIC and PIC devices; RF or high-speed testing experience is a plus.

- A sound understanding of PIC and/or EIC device structures and operation, including EIC-to-PIC interface architectures.

- Practical knowledge of design-for-test (DFT) methodologies and their implementation in integrated circuits.

We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. title: Sr Clinical Research Associate
description:
Veranex ’s mission as an Innovation CRO is to improve patient outcomes by accelerating our clients’ innovations to market. As the world’s only end-to-end professional services firm focused on MedTech, we take clients’ Vision to Velocity through our comprehensive service portfolio, with expertise in human centered design and product development, preclinical and clinical research, regulatory affairs, and market access and reimbursement consulting.
The Veranex Clinical Operations team is a dynamic group of professionals providing regulatory, quality and clinical services for the medical device industry. Our team supports start-ups, mid-sized private companies, and the largest corporations at all stages of the product life cycle. We work across a broad spectrum of technologies and treatment modalities. Our clients develop both next-generation and paradigm-shifting devices. Our product exposure includes implantables, instruments (manual, laser, robotic, etc.), capital equipment, combination products, software as a medical device (SaMD), medical mobile apps, in vitro diagnostics and more
About This Role:
Veranex has an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Senior Clinical Research Associate to support our Clinical Operations team. The Sr. CRA will participate in the planning, development, and execution of clinical trials to evaluate the safety, effectiveness and performance of medical devices. Under management supervision, the Sr. CRA will monitor assigned clinical trials to ensure adherence to the clinical protocol, applicable regulations, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) governing clinical studies. Location: Remote, US
What You Will Do:

• Responsible for ensuring that study investigators and coordinators comply with the study protocol, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), Code of Federal Regulations (CFRs), and Institutional Review Board (IRB)/Ethics Committee (EC) requirements during clinical studies by training/guidance of investigators/research coordinators, conducting periodic on-site evaluations and follow-up of corrective actions

• Acts as primary liaison to clinical sites.

• Conducts site qualification visits, study start-up activities (essential document collection), site qualification visits, site initiation visits and training, monitoring visits for source data verification (reported study data are accurate, complete, and verifiable from source documents in the site’s medical records), and site close-out visits. title: Devops Engineer
description:
Description
We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer to join the infrastructure team to build and maintain the infrastructure that powers reliable product delivery at scale. You will help ensure that engineering teams can ship faster, systems stay stable, and customers receive a seamless experience.
In this role, you will own and improve the platforms, automation, and processes behind our development lifecycle - from deployment pipelines and infrastructure reliability to monitoring and operational excellence. Your will work closely with client team and impact for delivering new features and how confidently we can run our products in production.
We are actively integrating AI and automation into all areas of the business and are looking for candidates with a mindset focused on improving efficiency, automating repetitive processes, and delivering a better user experience.
Key responsibilities

• Own and operate CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and the self-hosted runner fleet (Linux/macOS/Windows); keep deploys and rollbacks reliable and fast.

• Operate Kubernetes (Hetzner) and Helm-managed services; containerize and ship services with Docker.

• Operate and recover the data layer: MySQL/Percona XtraDB (multi-region replication), ClickHouse, Redis/Memcached, Kafka.

• Own the network/edge layer: nginx load balancing, Cloudflare/CDN, DNS, TLS certificates.

• Maintain the observability stack (self-hosted Sentry, Prometheus/Grafana, Graylog) and run its migrations.

• Maintain build infrastructure for mobile/desktop apps

• Serve as infrastructure on-call: incident response, coordination, and root-cause analysis.

• Use AI tooling to accelerate configuration, automation, diagnostics, and documentation.

Requirements

• Production CI/CD: Jenkins + GitHub Actions.

• Kubernetes + Helm; Docker.

• Strong Linux administration; nginx; operating PHP/php-fpm applications.

• MySQL/Percona XtraDB: replication, recovery, troubleshooting.

Continuous Learning & Self-Growth

title: KYB/AML Analyst, Sweden
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is launching payments across the EU through its Swedish payment institution. Our European operations team (Europs) onboards European businesses and keeps them trading, across Ramp's own regulated entities and our card-issuing and payments partners. We're a small team that runs on frontier AI tooling: our operators build and use their own automations so they can spend their time on judgement, not admin. We're hiring a KYB/AML Analyst in Stockholm to review and onboard business customers of our Swedish entity, work directly with those customers to get them live, and resolve onboarding requirements raised by our partners. You'll join a small Swedish team and help keep onboarding moving every day as we grow.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Carry out first-line (1LoD) KYB reviews of business customers onboarding with Ramp's Swedish payment institution: company verification, beneficial ownership, sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, and risk assessment

- Decide standard cases end to end, and escalate complex or higher-risk cases with a clear rationale

- Handle customer communications through onboarding: clear document requests, follow-ups and status updates

- Resolve onboarding requirements from our card-issuing and payments partners for EU customers

- Document decisions to a standard that holds up to second-line and regulatory review

- Keep Swedish casework moving when teammates are on leave or handling incidents

- Spend part of your time improving how we work: playbooks, templates and AI-assisted workflows

WHAT YOU NEED

- 2-4 years of KYB / AML / onboarding experience at a fintech, payment institution, EMI or bank

- Solid grounding in business customer due diligence: company registers, UBO identification, sanctions/PEP screening, and spotting red flags

- Fluent English, written and verbal

- Clear, friendly written communication with customers

- Curiosity about AI tools and how they can make casework faster and better

- Based in, or relocating to, Stockholm, with the right to work in Sweden

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Swedish (strongly preferred)

- Familiarity with Swedish sources and requirements (Bolagsverket, the beneficial ownership register, FI expectations under the Swedish AML Act)

- Experience onboarding EU businesses across several jurisdictions

- An additional European language

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual membership

- 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Pet insurance

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

- Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

GRC work is at its best when it makes security clearer, more consistent, and easier to operate. As a Security Engineer focused on Governance, Risk & Compliance, you’ll help maintain and improve Chainguard’s compliance and risk programs while building the experience and judgment to take on broader ownership over time.

You’ll work closely with experienced security and GRC partners to support SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 audit readiness, keep evidence and controls organized, help manage risk and remediation work, and improve the systems and processes behind our compliance program.

This is an earlier-career, hands-on role. You don’t need to have led an audit or built a GRC function before. We’re looking for someone with strong organizational habits, good judgment, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. You’ll have clear areas of responsibility, regular opportunities to work cross-functionally, and support from teammates as you grow your expertise.

•
Support audit readiness activities for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and other security assurance initiatives.

•
Coordinate evidence collection with teams across Security, Engineering, Legal, HR, Product, and other functions.

•
Help maintain security policies, standards, procedures, control descriptions, and supporting documentation.

•
Assist with control testing, risk assessments, gap analysis, and remediation tracking.

•
Keep compliance and risk information accurate and up to date in GRC platforms such as Vanta.

•
Help translate auditor, customer, and internal security requests into clear next steps for the right stakeholders.

•
Track action items, follow up on dependencies, and communicate status, risks, and blockers clearly.

•
Identify opportunities to simplify and improve GRC workflows through better documentation, automation, and use of modern tooling.

•
Develop and maintain repeatable processes, checklists, runbooks, and evidence-collection practices.

•
Support customer security reviews, questionnaires, and third-party risk activities as needed.

•
Learn Chainguard’s systems and security practices well enough to ask useful questions, identify inconsistencies, and escalate potential risks with clear context.

•
Partner with senior members of the Security and Governance, Risk & Compliance teams on projects that improve Chainguard’s security posture.

What we’re looking for:

•
2+ years of experience in information security, GRC, compliance, audit, risk, IT, or a related field; equivalent practical experience is welcome.

•
Experience supporting audits, control activities, risk assessments, security questionnaires, or compliance programs.

•
Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage details across multiple workstreams.

•
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain requests and findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

•
A structured, detail-oriented approach to documentation, evidence management, and follow-through.

Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Team

The Camera Firmware Platform team owns the foundation that every Verkada camera runs on. While our product firmware teams bring new camera categories to market, this team makes every camera in the fleet, both existing and future models, more reliable, faster, leaner, and more power-efficient.

• Edge Storage: We own the on-camera storage stack that turns every Verkada camera into a self-contained recording device. Our mandate is reliable, accessible, secure, and observable storage of customer video. Footage is preserved instantly across SD cards and raw NAND, even during network outages or sudden power loss, for millions of cameras and petabytes of video. This extends to the backend services that manage retention, cloud backup, and storage health across the fleet.

• Firmware Platform: Building on that foundation, we own the cross-cutting firmware systems underneath every camera feature: boot and shutdown, memory and power management, system state orchestration, IPC, observability, and firmware update. We build these once, for every camera model and SoC, so product teams can move fast without rebuilding the same infrastructure.

About the Role

As the Engineering Manager for Camera Firmware Platform, you will lead a highly technical team of storage and embedded systems engineers responsible for the reliability, performance, power, and stability of firmware running on a fleet of more than 1.8 million perpetually online devices. You will set the storage and platform roadmap, decide which fleet-wide investments matter most, and turn them into measurable improvements in footage retention, storage endurance, boot time, memory headroom, power draw, and crash rates.

You will partner closely with the Camera Firmware product team, Hardware, Streaming, Computer Vision, Cloud Infrastructure, Security, Manufacturing, and Product. You will also work with Verkada Linux, the shared OS layer across all Verkada product lines, to incubate platform capabilities on cameras and contribute them back for use across the company product lines.

This role combines deep technical leadership with people management. We are committed to a thriving in-office culture, and this role requires onsite presence at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

What You'll Do

Lead the team

• Lead and grow a team of storage, firmware, and systems engineers, and recruit and retain top-tier embedded talent as the team expands its charter.

• Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, career development, and execution management.

• Define the technical vision and multi-quarter roadmap for camera storage and firmware platform, balancing fleet-wide investments against support for new camera launches.

•

title: People Partner GTM
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're scaling from 1,000 → 4,000 employees across 50+ countries, and the complexity of our teams, hubs, and workflows is growing quickly. Our People Partners play a critical role in enabling leads, supporting peeps, and protecting performance and culture as we grow. As a People Partner at ElevenLabs, you'll sit at the intersection of leadership coaching, organisational design, performance, and day-to-day people guidance.

You'll be the dedicated People Partner for our entire Revenue organisation across North America and LATAM, working closely with the Revenue leadership team to understand their rhythms, challenges, and talent needs deeply. You'll meet proactively with leads and teams, unblock people issues, and help architect the organisation ahead of scale, with Employee Relations and employment counsel on hand when cases need them.

This is a high-impact role for someone who can context-switch quickly, advise with confidence, build trust across functions, and bring clarity and calm to fast-moving environments.

YOU WILL

- Act as the dedicated People Partner for Revenue across North America and LATAM, owning the people agenda for the organisation end to end.

- Partner deeply with the Revenue leadership team to improve team health, performance, talent density, and organizational clarity.

- Run proactive 1:1 sessions

title: Senior Clinical Research Associate
description:
JOB SUMMARY
The Senior Clinical Research Associate is responsible for the site management, site monitoring and close-out of assigned clinical trials investigator sites to ensure patient safety and quality study execution in accordance with applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards.
The Senior Clinical Research Associate role is accountable for site management and monitoring, managing investigator site relationships to ensure effective delivery of clinical trials (e.g. enrollment, database release), to safeguard the quality of investigator sites (e.g. patient safety, site quality and compliance with GCP), to maintain investigator and site staff engagement and satisfaction, and to enhance the company’s image with its external stakeholders.
The Senior Clinical Research Associate is responsible for the resolution of all protocol-related issues for assigned investigator sites and will work closely with the Site Care Partner, and other members of the study team, as required, in activities associated with the set-up, running and close out of sites in a clinical trial.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
Responsible for investigator site management and monitoring for assigned sites:
Clinical Trial Monitoring:

• Ensure proper conduct of clinical trials in accordance with the Study Monitoring Plan and applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards to achieve project goals, timelines and quality

• Manage assigned operational aspects for implementation of clinical trial activities at assigned investigator sites from site initiation through to database lock, ensuring relevant timelines and quality deliverables are met

• During study conduct, serve as the primary point of contact for assigned investigator sites. Work in partnership with and/or escalate to the SCP to ensure quality of site delivery

• Interface with the study team as needed, facilitate information flow between members of the study team, vendors and assigned investigator sites

• Partner with SCP to perform investigator site development, coaching and training of site personnel to ensure ongoing compliance with protocol and the safeguarding of patients; provide protocol training to, and address protocol related questions from the investigator site staff when required, including discussions on known/anticipated operational and clinical trial risks

• Attend investigator meetings when required (virtual or F2F).

• Provide enrollment support and ensure progress by responding to site activation and recruitment issues from investigators. Partner with SCP and the study team to define and support recruitment initiatives at site level

• Conduct onsite, remote/electronic monitoring as needed for study site initiation, routine monitoring and study site closure activities and ensure these are conducted accordance to the Study Monitoring Plan, SOPs and commensurate with emerging issues and technologies.

• Monitor site level AEs and SAEs and collaborate with the Drug Safety Unit and follow-up with investigators sites, as needed, to bring SAE reports required information to resolution

• Submit all required reports, documentation, updates and tracking within required timeframes, including but not limited to Trial Master File documentation, site reports, site follow up letters, protocol deviations, patient recruitment, clinical supply management, study progress and metrics

• Identify and resolve investigator site issues within required timeframes; agree and develop corrective and preventative actions with investigator and site personnel to close open issues and to prevent recurrence/persistence of issues

• Resolve data queries within required timelines, prepare investigator site close-out plan and conduct close-out activities within required timelines

• Ensures adequate oversight of the investigational product at the investigator site, including receipt, handling, accounting, storage conditions, and destruction activities.

description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Autonomy Integration Engineer within our Drone Stack team at Applied Intuition, you will serve as the technical anchor bridging hardware, edge software, and field flight operations. Split roughly 50/50 between the lab and the airfield, you will be responsible for bringing autonomous aerial systems from initial benchtop configuration to live operational flight.

In this role, you will configure embedded Linux environments, deploy and validate containerized software stacks, wire up mesh network topologies, and write key middleware glue code to keep subsystems communicating seamlessly. You are as comfortable with a soldering iron and oscilloscope at the bench as you are SSH-ing into an onboard computer over a mesh radio under field conditions.

This opportunity can also be located at our Drone Lab near Fort Walton Beach, Florida or HQ in Sunnyvale, CA (relocation offered).

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead System Bring-Up: Drive end-to-end hardware and software integration for unmanned aerial systems, moving platforms from benchtop prototyping to active flight test campaigns.

- Deploy & Configure Edge Software: Manage, configure, and deploy software stacks using Docker images, shell scripts, and Linux system tools across onboard computes and peripheral hardware.

- Field & Bench Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot vehicle networks, payload interfaces, and sensor links in real time using command-line tools (grep, less, journalctl, nano/vim) and hardware diagnostics (multimeters, oscilloscopes).

- Build Test Tooling & Glue Code: Develop Python and C++ scripts for data reduction, log analysis, system validation, and real-time subsystem verification.

- System Cabling & Electronics: Fabricate custom wiring harnesses, perform precision soldering, and define system-level architecture using clear block diagrams.

- Manage Communications & Networks: Configure IP routing, subnets, and local network interfaces between flight controllers, companion computers, radios, and ground control stations.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Experience: 5+ years of experience in robotics integration, flight test engineering, embedded systems, or autonomous vehicles (aerial background preferred).

- Linux & Networking Mastery: Deep practical comfort with the Linux CLI, file management, system logging, local IP routing, subnets, and containerized deployments (Docker).

- Hardware & Electronics Capability: Proven hands-on skills in wiring, custom cable assembly, bench soldering, and physical diagnostics using oscilloscopes and multimeters.

- Scripting & Glue Code: Strong proficiency in Python, C++, or She
